paper_metadata.title: Designing lightweight dual-phase refractory VNbTiSi-based eutectic high-entropy alloys for use at elevated temperatures

evidence.quote: novel lightweight (about 6.0 g/cm3 in density), refractory (melting point higher than 1630 ◦C) VNbTiSi-based dual-phase eutectic high entropy alloys (EHEAs) that consist of body-centered cubic (BCC) solid solution and tetragonal-structured silicide phase are designed.
We further introduced chromium and aluminum into the VNbTiSi alloy system, and three other eutectic alloys VNbTiCrSi, VNbTiAlSi, and VNbTiCrAlSi were prepared.
